run_prepare_dataset: run the prepare_dataset script to prepare segment-level data with F0 alignment for PGSLM training
run_align_f0: run the align_f0 function to align fundamental frequency contours to audio segment durations
run_prepare_seg_data: run the prepare_seg_data function to build a data dict with codes, durations, F0, and speakers
run_dump_seg_data: run the dump_seg_data function to write segment-level data to .npy and .txt output files
run_load_meta: run the load_meta function to load manifest config, audio paths, codes, durations, and speakers
